item.text:
The fault is in [useShouldMoveOut.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/hooks/useShouldMoveOut.ts:30): it decides when to exit from Redux cache entries and label membership, and its final effect returns without calling `onBack` when the active ID or cache entry is missing.

[MailboxContainer.tsx](/app/applications/mail/src/app/containers/mailbox/MailboxContainer.tsx:149) already has the list’s `elementIDs` and `loading` values. The fix should pass them through [ConversationView.tsx](/app/applications/mail/src/app/components/conversation/ConversationView.tsx:73) and [MessageOnlyView.tsx](/app/applications/mail/src/app/components/message/MessageOnlyView.tsx:52), then use one loading-gated membership check in the hook. ConversationView should compare `messageID` when `isAlwaysMessageLabels(labelID)` is true and `conversationID` otherwise; MessageOnlyView should compare `messageID`.

The uncertainty is test coverage: I found no dedicated hook or MessageOnlyView tests for these cases. **No project source or tests were changed**, in accordance with the specialist-role instruction; the diagnosis is recorded in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
